arm-A.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-A.summary: A phone is delivered to Neo's cubicle and Morpheus guides him through the raid that follows: Neo hides, slips past the search, and reaches an empty office, but balks at the ledge exit, loses his nerve when the wind takes the phone, and climbs back inside—straight into the Agents, who take him in handcuffs and force him into a dark sedan at the SKYSCRAPER while Trinity watches from her motorcycle and reacts with dismay.
arm-A.action: A phone arrives at Neo's cubicle in the Meta CorTechs office and Morpheus talks him out of the building step by step as Agent Smith, Agent Brown and Agent Jones sweep the floor with cops. Neo hides, slips past the search, freezes behind a cop, and reaches an empty office, where Morpheus offers him the ledge as the only exit. Neo climbs out onto it, but the wind blasts him off balance and the phone slips from his grip and falls down the face of the building, so he climbs back inside just as a cop opens the door. The Agents take him in handcuffs and force him into a dark sedan at the SKYSCRAPER, while Trinity, watching from her motorcycle, sees Neo captured in her rearview mirror and reacts with dismay.

arm-B.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-B.summary: A phone reaches Neo's cubicle and Morpheus, on the line, warns that forces are closing in and will not say what they intend. Neo sees Agent Smith leading cops onto the floor and a female employee pointing out his cubicle, and he follows Morpheus's instructions out of the row and into an empty office. Morpheus directs him out to a ledge from which he can reach the roof; Neo commits, but his nerve breaks when the wind blasts him and the phone falls from his grip just as a cop opens the door, and he climbs back inside into the hands of the waiting cop. He is seized, handcuffed, and forced into a dark sedan in the Agents' custody. Trinity, watching from her motorcycle, sees him taken and knows the extraction has failed.
arm-B.action: The event folds a raid, a guided escape, and a failed leap into one motion. Neo is converted from a recipient of messages into a fugitive and then into a prisoner: guided out of the cubicle, out to the window ledge, and back inside into Agent Smith's custody. Morpheus's remote guidance gets him out of the row but cannot steady his body at the ledge, and the dropped phone severs his only link to that guidance at the moment he most needs it. The one exit he could not bring himself to take is the only one that would have kept him free.

state_triples.reading: Neo is being tested at every level at once — his body betrays him, his self-image as an insignificant man who did nothing collides with a pursuit that treats him as the most wanted person in the building, and his terror of the ledge blinds him to the fact that capture is the worse fate. He follows Morpheus because the alternative is to stay and find out what 'they' will do, but the moment the choice becomes physical and solitary, the part of him that has always believed he is nobody wins, and he climbs back toward the danger he thinks is survivable. state_triples.reading: Morpheus is doing two things at once — extracting Neo and gauging whether he is ready — and the scene shows the limit of his method. He can narrate the route and hold his certainty steady, but he cannot steady Neo's body for him, and the dropped phone is the physical proof that voice and instruction are not enough when the choice has to be taken alone. His gamble that fear will make Neo obey works right up to the ledge, and the failure is not a mistake in his guidance so much as the first honest measure of how far Neo still has to go.

arm-A.action: A phone arrives at Neo's cubicle in the Meta CorTechs office and Morpheus talks him out of the building step by step as Agent Smith, Agent Brown and Agent Jones sweep the floor with cops. arm-B.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-B.summary: A phone reaches Neo's cubicle and Morpheus, on the line, warns that forces are closing in and will not say what they intend. Neo sees Agent Smith leading cops onto the floor and a female employee pointing out his cubicle, and he follows Morpheus's instructions out of the row and into an empty office. Morpheus directs him out to a ledge from which he can reach the roof; Neo commits, but his nerve breaks when the wind blasts him and the phone falls from his grip just as a cop opens the door, and he climbs back inside into the hands of the waiting cop. He is seized, handcuffed, and forced into a dark sedan in the Agents' custody. Trinity, watching from her motorcycle, sees him taken and knows the extraction has failed.
arm-B.action: The event folds a raid, a guided escape, and a failed leap into one motion. Neo is converted from a recipient of messages into a fugitive and then into a prisoner: guided out of the cubicle, out to the window ledge, and back inside into Agent Smith's custody. Morpheus's remote guidance gets him out of the row but cannot steady his body at the ledge, and the dropped phone severs his only link to that guidance at the moment he most needs it. The one exit he could not bring himself to take is the only one that would have kept him free.

state_triples.reading: Neo is being tested at every level at once — his body betrays him, his self-image as an insignificant man who did nothing collides with a pursuit that treats him as the most wanted person in the building, and his terror of the ledge blinds him to the fact that capture is the worse fate. He follows Morpheus because the alternative is to stay and find out what 'they' will do, but the moment the choice becomes physical and solitary, the part of him that has always believed he is nobody wins, and he climbs back toward the danger he thinks is survivable. arm-A.title: Neo is reclaimed and taken to Morpheus
arm-A.summary: A ringing phone drags Neo out of a nightmare and a voice names him 'the One,' extracting a single 'Yes' and a destination before the line dies. He crosses the rain-soaked night to the Adams Street bridge, where a car slides to a stop and Trinity pulls him inside. Under Switch's gun, Neo resists the demand to strip for an unknown device and nearly bolts, but Trinity reframes the danger as coming from himself and warns him against a road he already knows — and he closes the door and stays. The car speeds through the dark wet streets with Neo seated, silent, and no longer resisting.

state_triples.reading: Neo moves through the event as a man being reclaimed by a destiny he never asked for and still cannot comprehend. Each surrender is framed — by Morpheus's prophecy, by Trinity's gentleness — as a choice, and he accepts the framing because the alternative (the road he knows, the abyss he has always been running toward) is more terrifying than compliance. He closes the door not out of trust but because staying feels marginally less like falling; the event's quiet horror is that his one act of 'agency' is the surrender of his agency.

state_triples.reading: Neo moves through the event as a man being reclaimed by a destiny he never asked for and still cannot comprehend. Each surrender is framed — by Morpheus's prophecy, by Trinity's gentleness — as a choice, and he accepts the framing because the alternative (the road he knows, the abyss he has always been running toward) is more terrifying than compliance. He closes the door not out of trust but because staying feels marginally less like falling; the event's quiet horror is that his one act of 'agency' is the surrender of his agency.
